params.prompt: Premium editorial photograph of a miniature world on a clean light grey desk. Giant sheets of Ukrainian tax declaration forms and bank statements lie like a landscape, with neat printed tables, columns of numbers and small form headers reading «ПОДАТКОВА ДЕКЛАРАЦІЯ». Dozens of tiny HO-scale model figurines, accountants and inspectors in neat business clothes, work on the paper: two examine single digits through oversized magnifying glasses, one climbs a small ladder to check a tall column of numbers, two carry a giant highlighter and draw a turquoise marker line under a total, one ticks boxes on a clipboard, one stands next to a calculator as big as a car. Tilt-shift shallow depth of field, soft natural daylight, calm, precise and friendly mood, very tidy composition, generous empty space on the left third for a headline. Palette: white paper, light grey, graphite black details, turquoise #30D5C8 as the only accent color. No logos, no brand names.
